_readme: Single source of truth for CI's `acceptance` matrix: the full fixture/filter/simulator/wave definitions for every acceptance-family fixture. Both Scripts/ci-route.sh (to build the targeted, filtered matrix for a path-routed run) and .github/workflows/ci.yml's own 'full matrix' fallback (an unrouted run reads this same file in full, via the same script -- see ci-route.sh's `acceptance_matrix` output) read this one file, so there is exactly one place that knows the full fixture list rather than two independently-maintained copies that can silently drift apart. Per-fixture historical/rationale comments (why cli-commands is simulator "1" despite looking host-only, why xcode-wave-early-kill needs wave, why the four xcode-batch-testing-family fixtures exist at all, ...) are NOT duplicated here -- JSON has no comment syntax, and duplicating prose that can drift from the code it explains is worse than one clear pointer. See .github/workflows/ci.yml's own comment block directly above the `acceptance` job for that narrative, and Tests/MutantKitTests/Unit/CIAcceptanceMatrixClassificationTests.swift for the regression tests that keep this file, the real acceptance test suites, and ci.yml's wiring honest against each other.
